subject: Add a column in the reactive dataset and use row.names

messages.author: 35a6a3b135698555
messages.subject: Add a column in the reactive dataset and use row.names
parts:
Dear all,

this is my first post here and since several weeks I am working on a shiny app which since till now was no big problem. Google could always point me where to continue to read.

Just currently I am facing a limitation in my understanding how shiny works. Hope you can help me further.



Function description:
File is uploaded and stored in filedata(). I can access all date there and could do all my plots. Except my latest idea and wish. For ggplot I like to sort my data by using row.names.

The original R code:
test$group <- row.names(test)
test.m <- melt(test, id.vars = "group")

I do it step by step and then let me return the values in a table to see if my approach works.
Unfortunately I could not even complete the first step and found out with google that in reactive elements I cannot add a row or column.

My first approach was:  
boxplotdata1 <- reactive({
  filedata()$group <- row.names(filedata())
})

Ok, as no rows and columns can be added it cannot work.

Can someone please point me to the correct approach or list the functions which could apply?

Thank you,
Karl
